title: A null falsifies only a compulsory prediction

statements.text: Each registered arena returns pass, constraint, model split or falsification. A null result falsifies only a prediction the model declares unavoidable, so which couplings are compulsory, conditional or nullable is recorded before any data analysis, and no arena may borrow significance from another.

sources.quote: A null can falsify only a compulsory prediction.
The paper therefore records which couplings are compulsory, conditional or nullable before data analysis.
